scripts.check: tsc --noEmit && eslint . --quiet --max-warnings 0 --cache --cache-strategy content --cache-location .cache/eslint/ && prettier --check . --log-level warn --cache --cache-strategy content --cache-location .cache/prettier/cache && rumdl check . --quiet && lockfile-lint --path package-lock.json --type npm --allowed-hosts npm --validate-https --validate-integrity && action-validator .github/workflows/check.yml && action-validator .github/workflows/audit.yml && vitest run --coverage --silent --reporter=dot
scripts.fix: eslint --fix . --quiet --cache --cache-strategy content --cache-location .cache/eslint/ && prettier --write . --log-level warn --cache --cache-strategy content --cache-location .cache/prettier/cache && rumdl fmt . --quiet
